label: PF Backlog 609
title: Product run re-pointed the framework repo git remote (connect_remote walked up to the parent repo)
body: A generated-product run mutated the FRAMEWORK repo git remote. products/MyToDo is not its own git repo (no .git), so run_pipeline -> repo_setup.setup -> VCSManager(products/MyToDo).connect_remote(url) walked UP to the nearest .git (the PF clone) and set origin=https://github.com/srinikc/MyToDo on the framework repo. Observed: git remote -v in the PF clone showed origin=MyToDo; every subsequent fetch/push/ID-CAS went to the product repo; restored manually. Risk: silent pushes to the wrong repo (data loss / leakage).

analysis.implementation_strategy: Extend VCSManager/repo_setup: before connect_remote, resolve git root from the PRODUCT path; if git_root != product_path, either git_init the product dir or hard-fail with a clear error. Add a guard asserting the remote URL matches the product slug and that no ancestor .git is used when path lacks one.
dependency_findings: REQUIRES: repo_setup.setup / VCSManager must be locatable and tested
BLOCKS: BI-PF-0764 remote-CAS id authority (bad remote would poison CAS)
conflict_findings: Potential overlap with BI-PF-0255 (.gitignore/git rm) if both touch PF clone git state — keep changes scoped to product dir init
None in core/agent_runtime.py or APIs listed as candidates
duplication_findings: BI-PF-0764 touches Git-remote CAS authority but not the walk-up guard; RELATED only
BI-0024/BI-PF-0255 touch PF repo git hygiene, not product remote wiring
No existing backlog item fixes VCSManager path resolution
analysis.rationale: Data-loss/leakage risk from mutating the framework repo's remote; fix is a narrow guard in repo_setup/VCSManager with a regression test.
assumptions: products/<Name> should always be its own git repo when a remote is configured
run_pipeline can tolerate setup failing fast when repo is not initialized
VCSManager is the single entry point for connect_remote calls
risks: Silent pushes to wrong repo if guard regresses — add test asserting remote URL host/path
Auto git_init of product dir may surprise existing workflows
Worktrees/submodules edge cases could bypass the guard
evidence: git remote -v in PF clone showed origin=MyToDo
missing_info: Decide fail-fast vs auto git init for product dirs without .git
Confirm whether PF-clone protection should also add an env var like PF_PROTECT_PARENT_GIT
Whether remote-CAS (BI-PF-0764) should own the URL-match guard long-term
